claims.title: Compile the value of experiments under a declared product-posterior tree

quoted_fields.interface: The supplied compiler optimizes expected conditional squared-loss risk reduction for fixed observation batches on a supplied read-once multiaffine tree, with paid ancestor maintenance and numerical regret bounds. A distinct acquired derivation/audit accepts exact adaptive two-observation planning and the finite-feature order; the ordinary reversible-update baseline matches its O(nh) query cost.
quoted_fields.failure: Completed producer working result with an actual acquired independent adaptive-two-step/finite-feature derivation and audit at its stated mathematical scope. Other fixed-review/resolution files named by the producer are not supplied and their reported findings do not become acquired review receipts. Thirteen current-turn files have event-verified delivery; complete_history.jsonl is an uncertain late-event candidate and is NOT imported as verified source, manifest unavailable, additional referenced unattached files not inferred. No retry/alternate transfer, science replay, new sign-off or historical-priority/practical-advantage claim. Independent declared Beta posteriors, stationary DIRECT source access and supplied DISJOINT-scope multiaffine trees are essential. Conditional Bayesian risk is not a uniform frequentist MSE guarantee; fixed-batch and exact adaptive TWO-step results are not general adaptive optimality. All equally informed ordinary incremental methods may use the same representation and match it.

claims.title: Compile normalized responses for a declared future evidence class

quoted_fields.interface: The supplied response principle reduces worst target-posterior error over a finitely generated nonnegative evidence cone to mixtures of at most two rays. Exact masses, update closure and paid response construction govern reusable coarsening; chain and linear-response examples retain ordinary incremental comparators and explicit storage/acquisition limits.
quoted_fields.failure: Independent producer mathematical derivations with proofs supplied, not an external historical-priority clearance or a new general inference breakthrough. Future cumulative likelihoods must remain in the stated fixed cone/algebra, all evidence masses/response entries must be actually acquired, and exact/approximate construction,maintenance,whitening/coercivity/bit costs are paid. A small summary specification is not a cheap acquisition algorithm. Ordinary variable elimination,incremental products,Woodbury/Schur and reduced-order residual methods receive the same information/structures; no estimator-level speed separation follows. No Capital reproof or source-code execution.

claims.title: Retain the ordinary local-design win and the limits of cheap adaptive reuse

quoted_fields.interface: The supplied local-design recursion chooses hierarchical weighted roles from product evidence and can certify a decision with much less acquisition than a root value. Its ordinary decision-only method beats a full-cache acquisition bill. Exact horizon/channel-profile counterexamples and a conjecture-conditional shared-circuit obstruction bound the broader reuse interpretation.
quoted_fields.failure: Source-bound complementary working constructions and explicit failures, without a new scientific audit or priority claim. The reliability-design family is a fixed read-once four-majority hierarchy with only distinguished-child role assignments; actual source likelihood and anytime simultaneous coverage are required. Source acquisition is distinct from computational optimization. Shared-circuit lower bounds are conditional on an explicitly unproved preprocessed OuMv assumption, not unconditional hardness or failure of the read-once compiler. General-channel profile counterexamples do not assert that fully retained Beta hyperparameters are indistinguishable.
